glosses: To look slyly, or with the eyes half closed, or through a crevice; to peep.
To be only slightly, partially visible, as if peering out from a hiding place.

examples.text: A pale strip of white skin peeked out from under his waistband.
Her brown skin peeked through the empty gap in her clothing.

glosses: To retrieve (a value) from a memory address.

examples.text: We are peeking the value from the first index's memory location.
W dzieciństwie podglądali się, aż ich babka przyłapała.
